scripts.dev:backend:win: cross-env PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 NODE_ENV=development PORT=5010 PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/Scripts/python.exe backend/main.py
scripts.dev:backend:linux: cross-env PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 NODE_ENV=development PORT=5010 PYTHONPATH=backend .venv/bin/python backend/main.py
scripts.dev:backend: node -e "const p=process.platform==='win32'?'.venv/Scripts/python.exe':'.venv/bin/python';require('child_process').execSync('cross-env PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 NODE_ENV=development PORT=5010 PYTHONPATH=backend '+p+' backend/main.py',{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.start:win: npm run build && cross-env PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 NODE_ENV=production .venv/Scripts/python.exe backend/main.py
scripts.start:linux: npm run build && cross-env PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 NODE_ENV=production .venv/bin/python backend/main.py
scripts.dev:internal: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run wait:backend && npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && git push origin main --tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major && git push origin main --tags
